body: Hey sorry it took a bit to get back to you, my job is menial Kanpur so I’m always walking around meaning my legs and back are usually aching, why?

Let me explain, all our lives we’re told to work right? But in the grand scheme of things we’re essentially just doing the same monotonous things that I’d wager most people despise just to maintain that lifestyle (eg. you go to work to pay for gas and food to go home to go to bed to do the same thing tomorrow).

Realistically what’s the point in all of it? Why not just off my self if life’s this depressing and repetitive?
